To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ring diagram method with low-momentum nucleon-nucleons interactions can accurately describe nuclear binding energy.

(1) the nuclear binding energy can be well reproduced by the low momentum nucleon nucleon potential V_(Low-k) with the inclusion an in-medium 3N force V_(3n); (2) the ring diagram of order higher than the first order cannot be ignored; (3) the nuclear binding energies obtained from the Skyrme interactions are too weak;

the nuclear binding energy can be accurately reproduced using chiral two-nucleon potentials and the chiral N^4LO three-nucleon interaction in the ring diagram method, and that this method can be used to predict nuclear properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nuclear binding energy in the particle-hole-hole ring diagram method with low momentum interactions and the inclusion of the in-medium three-nuclear force.
the application of low momentum nucleon nucleon potential to the study of the binding energy of the nucleus $^{16}$0.
the nuclear binding energy in a ring diagram calculation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a realistic NN interaction is essential for a correct description of nuclear properties, and the ring diagram method is the only one which can provide a systematical way for the inclusion of the many-body force.
the chiral low momentum interactions are a promising tool for nuclear many-body theory, especially for the study of nuclear structure.
the ring diagram method with the low momentum interactions is a promising approach for the study of nuclear properties. (authors)
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nuclear properties are accurately reproduced with the chiral low-momentum nucleon-nucleons interactions.
the low-momentum interactions with the inclusion of the chiral 3N force can be used to describe the nuclear structure properties.

the ring diagram method is a promising tool for studying nuclear properties, and that the V_(low-k)-based chiral NN interaction with a chiral three-nucleon interaction is a good candidate for the nuclear many-body problem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nuclear binding energy can be reproduced with a realistic NN interaction, without any additional phenomenological parameters.
the nuclear binding energy can be accurately reproduced by using a realistic nucleon-nucleus potential and the ring diagrams of the order higher than 0.
the chiral N^4LO three-nucleon interaction is essential for the description of nuclear matter and finite nuclei.
